Use these worksheets during the classroom sessions. Predict what will happen,
run the experiment, and record your explanation with your partner.

## Get ready

[Follow the installation instructions](https://github.com/HealthML/deep-learning-exercises#install-python-and-create-an-environment)
to clone the student repository and install Python and PyTorch. The code runs
on CPU; no GPU or dataset download is needed for either week.

You can read the worksheets here in your browser. Quarto is only needed if you
want to render them yourself. Use the appearance toggle in the navigation bar
to switch between the black and light backgrounds.

## Classroom worksheets

| Session | Material |
|---|---|
| Week 1: fitting a line | [Open the worksheet](exercises/week01/worksheet.qmd) · [Experiment instructions and commands](https://github.com/HealthML/deep-learning-exercises/blob/main/exercises/week01/README.md) |
| Week 2: logistic regression | [Open the worksheet](exercises/week02/worksheet.qmd) · [Notebook and setup](https://github.com/HealthML/deep-learning-exercises/blob/main/exercises/week02/README.md) |

The runnable scripts, source worksheets, and figures are available in the
[student repository](https://github.com/HealthML/deep-learning-exercises).
